about.heroSubtitle: CineGenius connects creatives with locations, crew, equipment and jobs — for film, photography, social media and advertising in the DACH region.
about.missionP1: Anyone who has searched for a location knows the problem: hours of Googling, Instagram DMs, phone chains — and maybe one reply in the end.
about.missionP2: Anyone who wanted to book crew ended up at expensive agencies or happened to know the right people. Renting equipment was a matter of knowledge and trust.
about.missionP3: CineGenius brings locations, crew, talent, companies and offers together. Discover suitable contacts and agree availability, prices and collaboration directly.

about.missionPoint3: Discover companies and services including catering

about.valuesSubtitle: The principles behind every decision we make.
about.value1Desc: Every feature was born from real needs on set, at a shoot or during content production — not from a textbook.
about.value2Desc: Fair chances for everyone involved. Transparent terms protect both providers and seekers.
about.value3Desc: Contact providers directly and agree how to work together without an intermediary agency.
about.value4Desc: Better a few good listings than thousands of mediocre ones. We grow deliberately, slowly and thoroughly.
about.ctaDesc: Whether location owner, freelancer, company or seeker — CineGenius is for everyone who works creatively.

This share is included in the total price paid by the renter and retained at settlement. The remaining amount goes to the provider.

LegalAuditOriginal.newsRegionDisclosure: Regionale Branchennews: Ohne eigene Länderauswahl verwenden wir vorrangig das Land aus deinem Profil, sonst das vom Hosting-Anbieter übermittelte ungefähre Land deiner Verbindung. Dafür fragen wir keinen GPS-Standort ab. Deine ausdrücklich gewählte Einstellung speichern wir für bis zu ein Jahr in einem Cookie mit dem Präfix cg_news_country_, getrennt für Gäste und angemeldete Konten. Du kannst jederzeit ein anderes Land, „Alle Länder“ oder „Automatisch“ wählen. Die automatische Ländererkennung wird nicht in diesem Cookie gespeichert. Die Oberflächensprache folgt deiner gespeicherten Sprachwahl, sonst einer unterstützten Browsersprache; fehlt diese, dient das ungefähre Land als Rückfall. Originalbeiträge werden nicht automatisch übersetzt.
LegalAuditOriginal.genieVoiceDisclosure: Die freiwillige Sprachbedienung startet erst durch deine Mikrofonaktion und eine erforderliche Gerätefreigabe. Im Browser wird die beendete Aufnahme (höchstens 30 Sekunden und 1 MiB) über den CineGenius-Server an OpenAI zur Texterkennung übermittelt. In unterstützten nativen Apps übernimmt der Sprachdienst des Geräts die Erkennung; dabei kann eine Verarbeitung durch dessen Anbieter erforderlich sein. Bei leerem Eingabefeld wird der erkannte Text anschließend an Genie gesendet, andernfalls nur deinem ungesendeten Text hinzugefügt. Der KI-Dienst erhält die gesendeten Nachrichten, die letzten Gesprächsrunden, die Sprache und den groben Seitenbereich. Antworten können über die künstliche Stimme des Browsers oder Geräts vorgelesen werden; je nach gewählter Systemstimme verarbeitet deren Anbieter den Antworttext. CineGenius speichert keine Audiodateien. Abgeschlossene Textgespräche bleiben kurzzeitig kontogebunden im aktuellen Browser-Tab. Nach 10 Minuten ohne Bedienung von Genie wird dieser lokale Verlauf automatisch gelöscht; bei einer vom Gerät pausierten Seite geschieht dies beim Fortsetzen, vor der nächsten Anfrage. Ungesendete Eingaben und aktuelle Suchfilter werden dabei nicht gelöscht. Über den Papierkorb kannst du den Verlauf auch sofort löschen. CineGenius führt keine dauerhaft gespeicherte Suchhistorie; eine früher lokal gespeicherte Liste letzter Suchen wird beim Laden der aktuellen Website entfernt. Suchbegriffe in der aktuellen Seitenadresse und der vom Browser verwaltete Navigationsverlauf bleiben davon unberührt. Für die Missbrauchsbegrenzung werden Nutzungszähler geführt. Das Löschen des lokalen Verlaufs löscht keine bereits übermittelten Daten beim jeweiligen Dienst. Die Aufbewahrung bei OpenAI richtet sich nach dem verwendeten Dienst und seiner Konfiguration; deaktivierte Gesprächsspeicherung ist keine Zusage, dass keinerlei Sicherheitsprotokolle entstehen. Schließen, Abbrechen, Kontowechsel und der Wechsel in den Hintergrund beenden die aktuelle Aufnahme. Die Suche verwendet nur den von dir genannten Ort und ungefähre öffentliche Ortskoordinaten, keinen GPS-Standort. Sie kann passende Filter öffnen, veröffentlicht aber keine Inhalte und ändert keine gemeinsamen Arbeitspläne. Bitte sprich keine Passwörter oder unnötigen vertraulichen Angaben ein.

Ui.text_f02d146f3e098d: CineGenius is the free marketplace for the film and media industry in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Find locations, crew and talent, props, equipment, vehicles, animals for productions and open jobs — all in one place, directly without a booking agency.
Ui.text_7237cd1f700480: Do I need an account to browse?
Ui.text_5d7322b563f933: No — you can browse all locations, props, jobs and filmmakers without registering. You need an account only to get in touch, apply for jobs or post your own offers.
Ui.text_0e149f944a9c36: Registration, profiles, search and listings are currently free. Prices for rented items, locations or services are agreed with the provider.
Ui.text_35080d686eadb3: How do I contact a provider?
Ui.text_b1bedfc7113d76: Every listing has a contact button that opens the internal messaging function directly. You arrange everything else — prices, availability and terms — with each other.
Ui.text_14262cd693898d: How do I list my location?
Ui.text_b06c28a3d12af0: Sign in, open ‘Create listing’ and choose ‘Location’. Add basic details, filming conditions, up to 20 photos, pricing and availability. You can save a draft and publish only through the designated action.
Ui.text_44e28c14fa9ae7: Can I view a location before renting it?
Ui.text_2f3e72f1bf18d0: Ask the provider whether an in-person or video viewing is possible. A viewing is not automatically included in an offer.
Ui.text_0cb536e243bf67: How are prices and terms agreed?
Ui.text_284a3a0e13f1c7: Registration, profiles, listings, searches and direct contact through the platform are currently free. Support-arranged rentals: 5% included in the total rental price. If our services go beyond arranging the rental, a higher fee may be agreed. The scope of services and total fee are individually and expressly agreed before commissioning.
Ui.text_6b1f909fc968ae: How does prop rental on CineGenius work?
Ui.text_8dd5663d275cda: Find the item you need, view photos and the description, then contact the provider directly. You arrange availability, rental duration and collection personally — CineGenius is the directory; everything else happens directly between you.
Ui.text_5f048e755d7f6c: Can props be delivered to the set?
Ui.text_b0007f0e5db38e: Each provider decides for themselves. Send a message asking whether delivery is available and how much it costs.
Ui.text_dcff3d216808c3: What if a provider does not reply?
Ui.text_5401229f93f5f8: If you have not received a reply within 2–3 days, try again or contact another provider. You can also email cinegenius.co@gmail.com if a listing appears outdated or inactive.
Ui.text_0a4347d5f1b6c9: What vehicles can I find on CineGenius?
Ui.text_452b8ae2aeaf1e: CineGenius lists picture vehicles (e.g. classic cars, motorcycles), production vehicles (costume buses, make-up and hair vehicles, equipment transporters, generator vehicles, cast trailers and more), as well as vintage and special vehicles for film productions.
Ui.text_5e264fc254f41a: How do I list my vehicle?
Ui.text_2fc537a7d3fd9d: Click ''Create listing'' and choose ''Vehicle''. For production vehicles, you can also specify the exact type (e.g. costume bus or generator vehicle). Save your offer as a draft first or publish it using the designated action.
Ui.text_0a67cbacc429c2: How are rental and use arranged?
Ui.text_8576edc4aadf97: Registration, profiles, listings, searches and direct contact through the platform are currently free. Support-arranged rentals: 5% included in the total rental price. If our services go beyond arranging the rental, a higher fee may be agreed. The scope of services and total fee are individually and expressly agreed before commissioning.
Ui.text_8a8693ff819d35: Can I book animals for my production through CineGenius?
Ui.text_8baf134a3204b2: Yes — under ''Animals'' you can find trained film animals and experienced animal trainers for photography and film productions. From dogs and horses to exotic animals — providers list their animals with photos, training level and areas of work.
Ui.text_c28963b689a760: How do I list my animal or animal agency?
Ui.text_89fc1207c645ad: Click ''Create listing'' and choose ''Animals''. Describe the animal, its training and previous productions, and upload informative photos.
Ui.text_81914e6a8d6538: What requirements apply to animals on set?
Ui.text_53ee328cf84607: That is for the production and animal keeper to determine. CineGenius recommends clarifying animal welfare requirements, insurance and care in writing before filming starts. Keepers and productions are responsible for animal welfare on set.
Ui.text_9d21b13a0a1934: How do I apply for a job?
Ui.text_0fde0e5360432e: Open the job listing and use the contact button or application form. You can write a short application and link your portfolio. Further communication is directly with the production.
Ui.text_47fc5853a3022d: Is my data shared when I apply?
Ui.text_6f1b2038b1488b: The recipient sees your application and the relevant profile information. Publicly shared profile content is visible to visitors; personal contact details follow your visibility settings.
Ui.text_a09e33d4d9d83f: Can productions post jobs for free?
Ui.text_fedc2ddbecd3a3: Posting jobs, searching for crew and sending applications through the existing features are currently free.
Ui.text_9ecf3a88360bb2: How do I create a crew profile?
Ui.text_d78932ee50b0dd: After email verification, setup takes you through name, location, chosen areas and relevant occupations. Multiple departments and occupations are possible. Later you edit your profile in ‘My area’. Whether it appears publicly depends on the intended visibility.
Ui.text_f466f86a12a014: How do I present my company or catering business?
Ui.text_ddea6729a28713: Choose a company or service during setup and add your industry and services. Multiple relevant areas, including catering, are possible. A new company profile becomes public when saved; drafts of other offer types stay private until publication.
Ui.text_1ade5581502ca9: How do I link my profile to a company?
Ui.text_b169cf44e42adb: On the company profile, find the membership request under ‘More actions’. Choose roles and add a message if needed. Membership becomes public only after confirmation. Company representatives can invite registered members; those invitations must also be accepted.
Ui.text_4a610b516161ec: How many photos can I upload?
Ui.text_e1893e6dffad16: The marketplace allows up to 10 photos per item, and locations allow up to 20. The forms show supported formats and size limits. Personal profiles and companies have their own photo and gallery fields.
Ui.text_620b510d55014a: Public profile photos, covers and directly uploaded personal portfolio photos, as well as company logos, covers and galleries, may appear automatically. Project, marketplace, location and noticeboard images, private content and message attachments are excluded.
Ui.text_ecefd7ab0c5e0f: CineGenius connects people and offers for film, photography and content. Information is supplied by the members concerned. Check important details directly with the provider; you can report suspicious content.
Ui.text_768fcf92332f19: How do I report a suspicious listing?
Ui.text_08ec7448a5e8e5: Email cinegenius.co@gmail.com with the listing link and a short description. We review reports; a fixed processing time is not guaranteed.
Ui.text_98b2f10d612454: Your data is used only to provide the platform and is not sold to third parties. Details are in our privacy policy.

Ui.text_92732943717035: What should I watch out for?
Ui.text_0e024c5b72d5e2: Check the offer and provider, clarify the service scope and put agreements in writing. Do not transfer money solely because of an alleged platform quality seal.
Ui.text_78970f62dbacb2: Clarify cancellation, date changes, deposits and possible costs directly with the provider before committing. Your agreement and statutory rights are decisive.
Ui.text_9304f320d20c7a: There is no general automatic refund from CineGenius. For questions about the agreed service or payment, first contact your contracting party.
Ui.text_14495a684f86ed: How do I report a problem?
Ui.text_3550cab39bd557: Use the reporting function on the profile or offer, or send the relevant link with a description to cinegenius.co@gmail.com. Share only the information needed for review.
Ui.text_a2170631ea5282: Authorised representatives review the report. A fixed processing time or refund cannot be guaranteed in general. Support conversations may be handled by authorised support administrators.
Ui.text_085da4a0443384: Clarify liability, insurance and any deposits with your contracting party before use. A platform enquiry does not include automatic insurance cover.
Ui.text_ebd7ef4c997d0f: Pay attention to the specific label and what it refers to. A profile is not a blanket guarantee of identity, qualifications, ownership or the quality of every offered service.
